title: New civic agreement promises a fresh start for local communities
dek: Leaders say the cross-community package will put neighbourhood priorities at the centre of public investment.
takeaways: The agreement creates a five-year community renewal fund.
Local panels will help decide which projects move first.
The first funding round is expected to open this autumn.

content.heading: A new chapter
paragraphs: A new civic agreement has set out a five-year plan to revive high streets, improve public spaces and support local services. The package brings together councils, community organisations and business groups around a shared set of priorities.
Supporters described the plan as practical and measurable, with quarterly progress reports promised from the outset.

content.heading: What changes first
paragraphs: The first projects will focus on safer walking routes, vacant buildings and small grants for neighbourhood groups. Each district will publish a shortlist before final decisions are made.
Officials said the process was designed to make local knowledge visible in funding decisions rather than treating consultation as an afterthought.

content.heading: Community reaction
paragraphs: Residents welcomed the emphasis on visible improvements but said delivery would be the real test. Several groups called for clear timelines and accessible public reporting.
The first public meetings are due to begin next month, with project applications expected to follow in the autumn.

title: Rhys brings the ‘McIlroy effect’ to Irish gymnastics
dek: A breakthrough season is inspiring a new generation to take up the sport.
takeaways: Club registrations are rising nationwide.
Coaches say visibility is changing perceptions of the sport.

content.heading: A landmark season
paragraphs: Irish gymnastics is enjoying a rare moment in the national spotlight after a run of performances that made the sport impossible to ignore.
Clubs say young athletes are arriving with new heroes and a clear idea of what elite success can look like.

content.heading: The next generation
paragraphs: Coaches are responding with new beginner sessions and school partnerships. The challenge now is matching enthusiasm with facilities and trained staff.

title: Independent shops find new life on the high street
dek: A wave of small businesses is bringing fresh energy to once-empty units.
takeaways: Flexible leases are lowering barriers for new retailers.
Owners are combining shops with events and online sales.

content.heading: Room to experiment
paragraphs: Shorter leases and shared retail spaces are giving first-time owners an affordable route onto the high street.
Many are combining traditional shops with workshops, events and online fulfilment.

content.heading: A patient recovery
paragraphs: Footfall is improving, but traders say dependable transport and better public spaces remain essential.

title: Artists turn city walls into an open-air gallery
dek: A new trail connects ambitious murals with the stories behind them.
takeaways: The free trail features 18 new works.
Local schools helped develop several designs.

content.heading: Art in the everyday
paragraphs: Blank gables and overlooked lanes have become a city-scale exhibition in a project led by artists and residents.

content.heading: Stories on the walls
paragraphs: Each work responds to a local memory, from shipyard shifts to dance halls and corner shops.

title: Why good public spaces matter more than ever
dek: The places between our buildings shape health, trust and belonging.
takeaways: Welcoming public space is core infrastructure.
Maintenance matters as much as ambitious design.

content.heading: The shared room
paragraphs: A park bench, library step or sheltered square can be the place where a city becomes a community.
These spaces ask little of us while giving room to pause, meet and belong.

content.heading: Designing for dignity
paragraphs: The best public spaces are legible, safe and generous to people of different ages and abilities.

title: Harbour project clears major planning milestone
dek: The waterfront proposal includes homes, workspaces and a new public promenade.
takeaways: The plan adds a continuous waterfront path.
Construction could begin next spring.

content.heading: A connected waterfront
paragraphs: Plans for a mixed-use harbour district have passed a major planning stage after months of consultation.

content.heading: Next steps
paragraphs: A final design review will take place before enabling works can begin.

title: County final delivers a finish to remember
dek: A late point settled a breathless contest in front of a packed crowd.
takeaways: The winning score came in added time.
Both managers praised the atmosphere.

content.heading: A dramatic finale
paragraphs: With the teams level and the clock deep into added time, one final attack decided a compelling county final.

content.heading: What they said
paragraphs: Both managers pointed to the discipline and belief shown by their players.

title: Small venue, big sound: our summer music guide
dek: Six intimate shows that deserve a place in your diary.
takeaways: Independent venues dominate this year’s programme.
Several afternoon shows are family-friendly.

content.heading: Close to the stage
paragraphs: This summer's most exciting music is happening in rooms small enough to feel every beat.

content.heading: Six to see
paragraphs: From folk harmonies to restless electronic pop, the programme rewards curious listeners.

title: Food makers build a market of their own
dek: A shared production hub is helping small brands reach more shelves.
takeaways: Shared equipment reduces start-up costs.
The group plans a permanent market hall.

content.heading: Sharing the load
paragraphs: A group of independent producers has opened a shared kitchen, packing space and distribution hub.

content.heading: Growing together
paragraphs: Members say collaboration has helped them win larger orders without losing their identity.

title: Five walks for a clearer weekend
dek: From forest paths to sea air, these routes make space to reset.
takeaways: All five routes are suitable for casual walkers.
Public transport options are included.

content.heading: A gentler pace
paragraphs: You do not need a summit to feel the benefit of a good walk. These routes put scenery and simplicity first.

content.heading: Plan your route
paragraphs: Check the forecast, bring water and leave enough daylight for an unhurried return.

title: Schools launch shared reading project
dek: Pupils across twelve schools will read and discuss the same novel.
takeaways: Twelve schools are taking part.
The project ends with a student-led festival.

content.heading: One book, many voices
paragraphs: Thousands of pupils will share one story this term as part of a new cross-school reading programme.

content.heading: Beyond the classroom
paragraphs: Authors, librarians and illustrators will join workshops throughout the project.

title: The case for slower local news
dek: Being first matters less than being useful, trusted and close to readers.
takeaways: Context gives local reporting its lasting value.
Trust grows through consistency and correction.

content.heading: Beyond the alert
paragraphs: News alerts are useful, but they are rarely the whole story. Local journalism earns its place by staying after the first rush.

content.heading: A useful measure
paragraphs: The test is not only whether a story travelled, but whether it helped someone understand what happens next.
